title: Akira
author: xlanor, streetpea, kkwong, the chiaki-ng project
description: PS4 and PS5 Remote Play for the Switch 2.
details:
Akira streams your own PS4 or PS5 to the Switch 2 over Remote Play. You MUST own a PS4/5 to use this.

Features:
- Launch straight into a recently played game
- FSR 1.0 with tunable RCAS and dithering
- Upscale up to 4K (at your own performance cost)
- PSN trophies
- Button and touchpad remapping
- In-game diagnostics
- Hardware H.264 decode, software HEVC decode
- PSN registration by QR code, legacy base64 profile, or the companion app
- LAN and manual console discovery

If you cannot connect, pin the console to a lower Takion version.

Built with libounce, OunceVK, drako3d and uam2 from the ouncebrew project. Please accept the ouncebrew risks and disclaimers before using homebrew on the Switch 2.
